name: wp-atlas
description: A collection of reusable WordPress blocks.

scripts.version: sed -i '' "s/^ \* Version:.*/ * Version:           $npm_package_version/" wp-atlas.php && sed -i '' "s/define( 'WP_ATLAS_VERSION', '.*' )/define( 'WP_ATLAS_VERSION', '$npm_package_version' )/" wp-atlas.php && git add wp-atlas.php
